english.notes:
(i) CPS Advice - Make sure you know the CPS guidelines for this offence before preparing any charges. When investigating attempted murder consideration must be given to the advice offered in the assault charging standards.
(ii) Terrorist connection - this offence is listed in Schedule 1 to the Sentencing Act 2020. Where the court has determined that there is a terrorist connection, the court has to treat this as an aggravating factor in sentencing (section 69 of that Act) and the notification requirements under the Counter-Terrorism Act 2008 apply (section 42 of that Act). In addition, section 23A of the Terrorism Act 2000 provides for forfeiture of money or other property.
